**I help APRA-regulated risk and data teams build continuous AI assurance tooling** — the pipelines, controls, and observability that make ML and LLM systems auditable under CPG 235 and BCBS 239, not just demoable. I also take on quantitative research and end-to-end AI/ML delivery: from framing the question through to a system running in production.

Eighteen years shipping data platforms and quantitative systems in financial services, most recently leading data modernisation at Macquarie Group. [GARP-certified in Risk and AI (RAI)](https://my.garp.org/DigitalBadgeRAI?id=003Po00000vhhe4IAA) and [CFA Level 1](https://credentials.cfainstitute.org/bfdef667-3429-4965-8558-ebaf88125e2a), so neither the assurance nor the finance is bolted on. If you have models in production and a regulator who wants evidence they behave — or a research question that deserves a real system behind it — [let's talk](#work-with-me).

APRA's April 2026 letter now expects second-line functions to have tooling to independently assess AI systems. That tooling is what I build.

---

The rest of this site is a working archive — not a feed. It exists because I think in public.

Everything here is oriented toward **truth-seeking through analysis**:
quantitative reasoning where possible, first-principles thinking where necessary, and skepticism toward narratives that don’t survive contact with data.

## Work with me

I take on a small number of engagements where the problem is concrete and the stakes are real:

- **AI assurance and model governance** — continuous validation, drift and calibration monitoring, and audit trails that satisfy CPG 235 / BCBS 239 reviewers.
- **End-to-end AI/ML delivery** — scoping, data, modelling, and deployment, owned through to a system that runs and is maintainable.
- **Quantitative research** — portfolio analytics, economic time-series, and financial modelling, grounded in CFA Level 1 fundamentals and turned into reproducible systems rather than one-off notebooks.
- **Data platform modernisation** — DBT, Iceberg, Redshift, and observable pipelines, built so the lineage and controls are first-class, not bolted on.

If that maps to a problem you have, email **[bose.debasish@gmail.com](mailto:bose.debasish@gmail.com)** or read more [about my background](./about.qmd).

### Papers
